D2Digital

Random / Turing Machine

Randomness you can lock in

Generates a new control voltage on every clock from a shift register. The sequence repeats exactly, drifts slowly or stays fully random.

  • Loop length from 2 to 16 steps
  • PROB sets how much the loop changes
  • Eight RGB LEDs show the register
Width8 HP · 40.4 mm
Height3 U · 128.5 mm
Jacks4
Knobs2
Switches and buttons1
